items.title: Papers: Man City set for late Fernandez move as Chelsea replacement emerges
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Wednesday's newspapers...

items.title: 'Truly honoured' - Shaw wins PFA player of the year award
items.description: Manchester City forward Khadija Shaw reacts to winning her second PFA player of the year award in three seasons.

items.title: Wilson scores on full debut as Brentford hit Birmingham for six
items.description: Callum Wilson scored just six minutes into his full debut and captain Nathan Collins converted two headers as Brentford routed Championship side Birmingham 6-1.

items.title: Leeds earn second win at Forest in three days in Carabao Cup
items.description: Leeds United registered a second win at Nottingham Forest in three days as they booked their spot in the Carabao Cup third round.

items.title: Coventry latest: Lampard pleased to cast eye over squad in cup win at Plymouth
Coventry survive Plymouth scare to progress in Carabao Cup
items.description: Premier League new boys Coventry survived an EFL Cup second-round scare at League One Plymouth before easing through 4-2 at Home Park.

items.title: Nunez's halfway stunner helps Ipswich past Leicester
items.description: Marcelino Nunez scored a sensational goal from the halfway line to help Ipswich claim a hard-fought 3-1 win over Leicester in the Carabao Cup.

items.title: Hull require penalties to overcome stubborn Stoke
items.description: Premier League new boys Hull followed up their 2-0 win over Manchester United on Saturday by knocking Stoke out of the Carabao Cup on penalties after a 1-1 draw at the bet365 Stadium.

items.title: West Ham hit back to thump four past Southampton
items.description: Teenager Josh Ayala scored twice on his full professional debut as West Ham came from behind to thrash Championship rivals Southampton 4-1 in the Carabao Cup.

items.title: 'I'm very proud of this' - Fernandes wins PFA player of the year
items.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes reacts to winning the men's 2026 PFA player of the year award.

items.title: Cardiff's Anyadike, 15, sets new EFL Cup record as youngest player
items.description: Cardiff City's Noah Anyadike, 15, becomes the youngest player in EFL Cup history after starting their second-round defeat against Norwich City.

items.title: 'A huge award' - O'Reilly named PFA young player of the year
items.description: Manchester City and England full-back Nico O'Reilly says "it feels amazing" after receiving the 2026 PFA young player of the year award.
